definition_zh: 棍；棒；枝条；手杖；粘住；卡住；坚持；容忍
definition_en: a thin piece of wood, or to become fixed to something and stay there
core_image: 一根捡起的枯枝插进雪里立住——插下就不再倒
scene: 雪后的公园里，孩子用树枝在雪地上画着大圈。She drew a huge circle in the snow with a long stick.
sceneCN: 这里 stick 是名词「棍；枝条」（第 1 个义项：细长的木条）；句意为她用一根长树枝在雪地上画了一个大圆圈。

collocations.phrase: stick a poster on the wall

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「黏的；黏性的；棘手的」
由形容词加名词后缀构成，义为「黏性；黏度」
由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「贴纸；不干胶」

senses.title: A thin piece of wood broken from a tree
senses.definition: a long thin piece of wood, especially one cut or broken from a tree
senses.definitionCN: 细长的木条，尤指从树上折下或砍下的
senses.example: The dog chased the stick and brought it back.
senses.exampleCN: 狗追着树枝跑，把它叼了回来。
senses.why: The branch planted upright in snow, still holding its tree shape.
senses.whyCN: 插进雪里立住的枯枝，还带着树的形状。

senses.title: To be fixed to a surface and stay
senses.definition: to be attached to something by gluing, suction, or pressure
senses.definitionCN: 因胶、吸附或按压而附着在物体表面
senses.example: The stamp would not stick because the envelope was damp.
senses.exampleCN: 信封太潮，邮票粘不住。
senses.why: The branch pushed into snow stays exactly where it lands.
senses.whyCN: 插进雪里的树枝停在落地之处，不再移动，即粘附。

senses.title: To be caught or jammed and unable to move
senses.definition: to become fixed in a place so that movement is blocked
senses.definitionCN: 被卡在某个位置以致无法移动
senses.example: The key stuck in the frozen lock.
senses.exampleCN: 钥匙卡在冻住的锁里了。
senses.why: Pushed in too far, the branch will not come back out.
senses.whyCN: 插得太深的枝条拔不出来，即卡滞。

senses.title: To continue firmly with a plan or belief
senses.definition: to keep following a decision, plan, or promise without changing
senses.definitionCN: 不改初衷地继续执行决定、计划或承诺
senses.example: She stuck to her diet even at the party.
senses.exampleCN: 即使在聚会上她也坚持节食。
senses.why: The branch stays planted through wind instead of falling over.
senses.whyCN: 枝条在大风中仍立定不倒，即坚持。

senses.title: To put something somewhere quickly or firmly
senses.definition: to push something into or onto a place, often quickly, as in stick a note on the door
senses.definitionCN: 把某物快速或用力推入或贴上某处，如把便条贴在门上
senses.example: Just stick your name here and sign below.
senses.exampleCN: 把名字写在这里，然后在下面签名就行。
senses.why: The planting motion, done with a casual hand.
senses.whyCN: 随手一插的动作，即快速放置。

intro.en: Stick is an Old English word for a thin branch, from a root of piercing or pricking.
intro.cn: stick 源自古英语，指细枝，词根一般认为与刺、戳相关。

items.en: A reconstructed root *stikk- is thought to mean to prick or pierce with a point.
items.cn: 一般认为重构词根 *stikk- 意为以尖端刺、戳。

items.en: Sticca meant a thin stick or twig, a pointed little branch.
items.cn: 古英语 sticca 指细棍、细枝，即带尖的小枝条。

items.en: The verb of piercing gave the sense of fixing into a place, then of staying fixed.
items.cn: 中古英语由「刺入」生出「插入固定」，再引申为停留不动。

items.en: Stick to a plan borrowed the fixed image for loyalty and persistence.
items.cn: stick to a plan 借「固定不动」意象表达坚守与执着。

items.en: Adhesive uses, traffic jams, stickers, and sticky situations spread across daily speech.
items.cn: 胶粘、堵车、贴纸与 sticky situations（棘手局面）等用法进入日常用语。

note.en: Stick shares its root with stitch and sticky, and sits near different-root words for rods and clinging.
note.cn: stick 与 stitch、sticky 同根，义场靠近词源不同的「杆棒」与「依附」词。

entries.definition: a loop of thread in sewing, or a pain in the side
entries.definitionCN: 针脚；（肋部）刺痛；与 stick 同源于「刺」

entries.definition: covered with a substance that clings
entries.definitionCN: 黏的；由 stick 加后缀构成

entries.definition: a neat pile of things one on another
entries.definitionCN: 堆；垛；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: a straight thin bar of wood, metal, or plastic
entries.definitionCN: 杆；棒，强调笔直规整

entries.definition: to stick firmly to a surface, or to remain loyal to
entries.definitionCN: 黏附；恪守，是 stick 的正式说法

entries.definition: to hold on tightly to something
entries.definitionCN: 紧贴；依附，强调抓紧不放

entries.definition: to let go of something held or stuck
entries.definitionCN: 释放；松开，与粘住相反

normalIntro.en: One image serves all senses: the branch planted in snow that stays, jams, and holds.
normalIntro.cn: 一个画面贯穿各义项：插在雪里、立住、卡住、支撑的枝条。

normal.en: Stick, stuck, stuck is the irregular verb chain to memorize.
normal.cn: stick—stuck—stuck 是需记住的不规则动词链。

normal.en: Stick to the plan is the classic phrase for persistence.
normal.cn: stick to the plan 是表达坚持计划的经典说法。

normal.en: Get stuck in traffic uses the jam sense everyone knows.
normal.cn: get stuck in traffic 用的是人人都懂的「卡住」义。

normal.en: A sticky situation is trouble that is hard to get out of.
normal.cn: a sticky situation 指难以脱身的麻烦局面。

normal.en: Stick together means to support each other as a group.
normal.cn: stick together 指团队互相支持、团结一致。

abstract.en: Push a branch into fresh snow and watch it stand alone.
abstract.cn: 把树枝插进新雪，看它独自立住。

abstract.en: Feel glue grab between finger and paper and refuse to let go.
abstract.cn: 体会胶水在指尖与纸间黏住不放的触感。

abstract.en: Picture a car frozen between two trucks in a narrow lane.
abstract.cn: 想象小车在窄巷被两辆卡车夹住动弹不得。

examples.en: He stuck the notice on the board with two pins.
examples.cn: 他用两枚图钉把通知钉在布告板上。

examples.en: We stuck to our budget and finished the trip under cost.
examples.cn: 我们坚持按预算行事，旅行花费低于预期。

examples.en: My sleeve got stuck in the car door.
examples.cn: 我的袖子被车门夹住了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯迪克」——谐音「死地磕」：棍子插进死硬的地面，磕也磕不动。

root: 源自古英语 sticca（细枝、细棍），一般认为上溯至日耳曼语 *stikk-（刺、戳）；同源词有 stitch、sticky 等；与 stack、stake 无词源关系。

sensesIntro.en: From the planted branch grow gluing, jamming, loyalty that stays put, and the quick act of pushing something into place.
sensesIntro.cn: 从插立的枝条生长出胶粘、卡滞、坚定不移，以及随手插放的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a branch planted in snow that will not fall or pull free
core.cn: 核心意象：插进雪里、不倒也拔不出的枝条

branches.en: the wooden piece itself
surfaces that hold what touches them
wedged too deep to move
loyalty planted like the branch
branches.cn: 像枝条一样立定的坚守

branches.en: the casual push that plants something

intro.en: The prick-root family turns one sharp image into needles, glue, and grit.
intro.cn: 「刺」词根家族把一个尖锐意象化为针脚、胶黏与坚毅。

latinIntro.en: Stick has no Latin relatives; it is native Germanic, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: stick 没有拉丁同源词，属日耳曼本土词源，故拉丁同族词列表为空。

items.meaning: thin wood; to fix or cling
a paper that clings to a surface
a sewing loop; a sharp side pain
to stick firmly; to stay loyal
makes nouns for things or doers

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀 -y 构成，义为「黏的；棘手的」
由形容词加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「黏性；黏度」
由本词加名词后缀 -er 构成，义为「贴纸；不干胶」

definition_zh: 硬的；僵硬的；不易弯的；生硬的；拘谨的；激烈的；（使）僵硬；（价格等）过高
definition_en: firm and hard to bend, or not moving easily because of cold or injury; also unnaturally formal
core_image: 冻在窗框上的抹布——掰都掰不动
scene: 清晨出门取报，寒气让门把手冰手。My fingers went stiff with cold while I waited outside the shop.
sceneCN: 这里 stiff 是形容词「僵直的」（第 1 个义项：受冷或受伤后不易活动）；句意为我在店外等的时候手指冻僵了。

pos.zh: 形容词：硬的；僵硬的；生硬的；激烈的
动词：使僵硬；（口语）诈取；不给小费

collocations.zh: 在这笔交易上被坑（口语）

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「僵硬地；生硬地」
由形容词加名词后缀构成，义为「僵硬；硬度；生硬」
由本词加动词后缀构成，义为「使变硬；变硬」
由本词加动词后缀加副词构成，义为「变僵硬」

senses.title: Firm and not easy to bend
senses.definition: firm and rigid so that bending is difficult
senses.definitionCN: 坚硬而有刚性，不易弯曲
senses.example: New leather shoes are stiff until you wear them in.
senses.exampleCN: 新皮鞋很硬，穿几天才变软。
senses.why: The frozen cloth on the window frame: it keeps its shape and resists your hand.
senses.whyCN: 冻在窗框上的抹布：保持形状、抗拒手劲，即硬挺。

senses.title: Not able to move easily, from cold or injury
senses.definition: painful and difficult to move, as after exercise, injury, or cold
senses.definitionCN: 因运动、受伤或寒冷而疼痛难动
senses.example: He felt stiff after sleeping on the hard floor.
senses.exampleCN: 在硬地板上睡了一夜，他觉得浑身发僵。
senses.why: The same resistance, now living inside the body's joints.
senses.whyCN: 同样的抗拒感，只是移进了身体的关节里。

senses.title: Not natural or relaxed; too formal
senses.definition: unnaturally formal or awkward in manner
senses.definitionCN: 举止不自然、过于正式而显得生硬
senses.example: She gave a stiff smile and turned away.
senses.exampleCN: 她僵硬地笑了笑，转身走开。
senses.why: A face that cannot bend into an easy smile.
senses.whyCN: 一张弯不出自然笑容的脸，即拘谨生硬。

senses.title: Intense and demanding; severe
senses.definition: strong, harsh, or hard to beat, as in stiff competition or a stiff penalty
senses.definitionCN: 强烈、严苛或难以击败的，如激烈竞争、严厉处罚
senses.example: The café faces stiff competition from the chain next door.
senses.exampleCN: 这家咖啡馆面临隔壁连锁店的激烈竞争。
senses.why: A wind so hard to bend against it nearly stops you walking.
senses.whyCN: 顶得人寸步难行的硬风，即严酷激烈。

senses.title: Very strong, as a drink or a fine
senses.definition: strong in effect, as alcohol with much spirit, or a price on the high side
senses.definitionCN: 效用强烈，如酒精含量高的酒，或偏高的价格
senses.example: That was a stiff drink—half of it was whiskey.
senses.exampleCN: 那杯酒真烈——一半都是威士忌。
senses.why: The blow that does not bend you but knocks you flat.
senses.whyCN: 一口下去不打弯、直接把人放倒的冲击力。

intro.en: Stiff is an Old English word for rigid, from a Germanic root of being rigid or firm.
intro.cn: stiff 源自古英语，指坚硬僵直，一般认为出自日耳曼语「刚硬」词根。

items.en: A reconstructed root *stif- is thought to mean rigid or inflexible.
items.cn: 一般认为重构词根 *stif- 意为僵硬、不弯。

items.en: Stif meant rigid and firm, of bodies, boards, and punishments alike.
items.cn: 古英语 stif 指坚硬僵直，既形容肢体也形容木板与刑罚。

items.en: Stif kept the rigid sense and stretched to harsh wind, hard duties, and strong drink.
items.cn: 中古英语 stiff 沿用僵硬义，并延伸到烈风、严苛差事与烈酒。

items.en: The formal-manner sense grew: a stiff bow, a stiff greeting.
items.cn: 生硬拘谨义发展起来：僵硬的鞠躬、刻板的寒暄。

items.en: Slang added stiff for a corpse and stiffed for cheating, while stiffen and stiffness formed.
items.cn: 俚语又添 stiff 指尸体、stiffed 指坑骗，并派生出 stiffen 与 stiffness。

note.en: Stiff looks like the unrelated stick, and sits near hardness words of different roots.
note.cn: stiff 拼写上与不相关的 stick 相近，义场靠近词源不同的坚硬词。

entries.definition: a thin piece of wood, or to become fixed to something
entries.definitionCN: 棍；粘住；与 stiff 只差一个字母，词源不同

entries.definition: not moving; continuing until now
entries.definitionCN: 静止的；仍然；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: the people working in an organization, or a long stick
entries.definitionCN: 员工；手杖；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: stiff and not able to bend or change
entries.definitionCN: 刚性的；死板的，较正式，兼指规则不容变通

entries.definition: solid and strongly fixed, not soft
entries.definitionCN: 坚固的；结实的，强调支撑力

entries.definition: soft and lacking firmness
entries.definitionCN: 软塌的；无力的，与僵硬相反

entries.definition: severe and unkind, as punishment or criticism
entries.definitionCN: 严酷的；苛刻的，对应 stiff 的严厉义

normalIntro.en: One frozen-cloth image stretches from boards and joints to prices and drinks.
normalIntro.cn: 一个「冻硬的抹布」画面可以从木板、关节延伸到价格与烈酒。

normal.en: Stiff and stick differ by one letter: hard or stuck.
normal.cn: stiff 与 stick 只差一个字母：硬或粘。

normal.en: Stiff muscles after exercise is the everyday body sense.
normal.cn: 运动后肌肉发僵是日常身体义。

normal.en: Keep a stiff upper lip is a fixed idiom for staying calm under trouble.
normal.cn: keep a stiff upper lip 是遇事不动声色的固定习语。

normal.en: Stiff competition and a stiff penalty show the harsh side.
normal.cn: stiff competition 与 stiff penalty 体现严苛义。

normal.en: Stiffen is the verb: cold weather stiffens your hands.
normal.cn: 动词是 stiffen：寒冷使手变僵。

abstract.en: Try to bend a board frozen solid and feel it refuse.
abstract.cn: 试着弯折冻硬的木板，感受它纹丝不弯。

abstract.en: Feel your neck refusing to turn on the morning after exercise.
abstract.cn: 体会运动次日早晨脖子转不动的感觉。

abstract.en: Picture a handshake so formal it could crack.
abstract.cn: 想象一个僵硬得几乎会咔咔作响的握手。

examples.en: The old boots were so stiff that they hurt my ankles.
examples.cn: 这双旧靴子硬得磨脚踝。

examples.en: The painting competition draws stiff entries every year.
examples.cn: 绘画比赛每年都竞争激烈。

examples.en: He answered in a stiff voice and left.
examples.cn: 他用生硬的语气回答后就离开了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯迪夫」——谐音「死抵」：冻僵的东西死死抵住，怎么掰都不弯。

root: 源自古英语 stif（僵直坚硬），一般认为上溯至日耳曼语 *stif-（僵硬不弯）；与 stick、still 无词源关系。

sensesIntro.en: From the unbending board grow the frozen joint, the awkward manner, the harsh wind of competition, and the drink that knocks you flat.
sensesIntro.cn: 从折不弯的木板生长出冻僵的关节、生硬的举止、激烈的竞争与一口放倒的烈酒。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cloth frozen stiff on the window frame that refuses to bend
core.cn: 核心意象：冻在窗框上、掰都掰不动的抹布

branches.en: material that resists bending
the body's joints refusing to move
a manner frozen into formality
the harsh force of wind, rules, and drink
branches.cn: 风、规则与酒的严酷冲击力

branches.en: the same resistance in things and bodies
branches.cn: 物与身共享的同一份抗拒

intro.en: Stiff makes a small but useful family around hardness.
intro.cn: stiff 围绕「坚硬」构成一个小而实用的词族。

latinIntro.en: Stiff has no Latin relatives; it is native Germanic, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: stiff 没有拉丁同源词，属日耳曼本土词源，故拉丁同族词列表为空。

items.meaning: in a rigid or formal way
to become rigid, often of the body

items.meaningCN: 刚性的；死板的（正式说法）

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「僵硬地；生硬地」
由形容词加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「僵硬；硬度；生硬」
由本词加动词后缀 -en 构成，义为「使变硬；变硬」

definition_zh: 静止的；不动的；无风的；仍然；还；尽管如此；平静；静止画面
definition_en: not moving; continuing until now; nevertheless; the quiet of no movement
core_image: 深夜湖面纹丝不动，倒影和实物分不出彼此
scene: 冬夜湖边散步，四周静得能听见心跳。The lake was perfectly still under the full moon last night.
sceneCN: 这里 still 是形容词「静止的；平静的」（第 1 个义项：一点不动）；句意为昨夜满月下湖面纹丝不动。

pos.zh: 形容词：静止的；无风的；平静的
副词：仍然；还；更；尽管如此
名词：静止画面；蒸馏器；（诗）寂静

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加名词后缀构成，义为「寂静；静止」
由本词加复合成分构成，义为「死产的；胎死腹中的」
由名词加介词短语构成的常用表达，义为「内心的宁静」

senses.title: Not moving at all
senses.definition: completely without movement or sound, as water or air
senses.definitionCN: 完全不动、无声，如水或空气
senses.example: The forest was still before the storm arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨来临前，森林里一片寂静。
senses.why: The mirror lake: reflection and reality cannot be told apart.
senses.whyCN: 镜面之湖：倒影与实物分不出彼此，即纹丝不动。

senses.title: Continuing to be so, up to now
senses.definition: continuing until the present time or a stated time, used as an adverb
senses.definitionCN: 持续到当前或所说的时间，作副词使用
senses.example: My grandmother still writes letters by hand.
senses.exampleCN: 我祖母仍用手写信。
senses.why: The lake holds its mirror face hour after hour without change.
senses.whyCN: 湖面小时小时地保持着镜面，未曾改变，即仍然。

senses.title: Despite that; nevertheless
senses.definition: in spite of what has just been said, used to introduce a contrast
senses.definitionCN: 尽管刚说过的话成立，仍引出转折
senses.example: The plan is costly; still, it is the best option we have.
senses.exampleCN: 这个计划成本很高，尽管如此，它仍是我们最好的选择。
senses.why: The surface stays calm, even while the current underneath argues.
senses.whyCN: 湖面平静依旧，哪怕水下暗流在争辩，即转折。

senses.title: To an even greater degree
senses.definition: even more than something already large or extreme, as in still harder
senses.definitionCN: 比已经很大或极端的程度更甚，如 still harder
senses.example: The next exam will be still harder than this one.
senses.exampleCN: 下一次考试会比这次还要难。
senses.why: Push the calm lake one degree further toward frozen glass.
senses.whyCN: 把平静的湖面再推进一步，直到冻结如玻璃，即更甚。

senses.title: A single photographed frame; or to calm something
senses.definition: one photograph from a film, or to make movement or emotion stop
senses.definitionCN: 从影片中截取的一帧照片，或使动作、情绪停止
senses.example: The film's stills were printed in the magazine.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影的剧照被印在了杂志上。
senses.why: One frozen instant lifted out of the moving world.
senses.whyCN: 从流动世界中截取的一帧凝固瞬间。

intro.en: Still is an Old English word for fixed or unmoving, from a Germanic root of standing or staying.
intro.cn: still 源自古英语，指固定的、不动的，一般认为出自日耳曼语「立定、停留」词根。

items.en: A reconstructed root *stilli- is thought to mean fixed or motionless.
items.cn: 一般认为重构词根 *stilli- 意为固定、不动。

items.en: Stille meant unmoving and quiet, of water, wind, and people alike.
items.cn: 古英语 stille 指不动的、安静的，兼用于水、风与人。

items.en: Still took on the adverb senses of continuing and of nevertheless.
items.cn: 中古英语 still 发展出「仍然」与「尽管如此」的副词义。

items.en: The intensifier use (still more) and the noun for a distilling apparatus grew.
items.cn: 程度递进用法（still more）与蒸馏器名词义兴起。

items.en: Cinema added the photographic still, and stillness returned as a prized quality.
items.cn: 电影时代添了剧照之义，stillness（寂静）重新成为被珍视的品质。

note.en: Still looks like the unrelated stiff and stick, and sits near quiet words of different roots.
note.cn: still 拼写上与不相关的 stiff、stick 相近，义场靠近词源不同的安静词。

entries.definition: firm and hard to bend
entries.definitionCN: 僵硬的；与 still 只差一个字母，词源不同

entries.definition: a thin piece of wood, or to become fixed
entries.definitionCN: 棍；粘住；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: no longer fresh, as old bread
entries.definitionCN: 不新鲜的；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: making little or no sound
entries.definitionCN: 安静的；轻声的，强调声音低

entries.definition: completely without movement
entries.definitionCN: 一动不动的，专指没有动作

entries.definition: still; up to now, or nevertheless
entries.definitionCN: 还；仍然；然而，与 still 的副词义相近

entries.definition: changing position or strongly affecting emotion
entries.definitionCN: 移动的；动人的，与静止相反

normalIntro.en: The mirror-lake image carries the adjective, and its unchanged hour carries the adverb.
normalIntro.cn: 镜湖画面承载形容词义，湖面长时的不变承载副词义。

normal.en: Stand still and hold still are the common commands.
normal.cn: stand still 与 hold still 是常用的口令表达。

normal.en: Still working, still waiting show the continuing sense.
normal.cn: still working、still waiting 体现「仍然」义。

normal.en: Still, it worked shows the contrast sense after a comma.
normal.cn: Still, it worked（不过还是成功了）逗号后引出转折。

normal.en: Still waters run deep is a famous proverb.
normal.cn: Still waters run deep（静水流深）是著名谚语。

normal.en: A still life is a painting of unmoving objects.
normal.cn: still life 指静物画，即描绘不动之物的绘画。

abstract.en: Look into a night lake where the moon sits perfectly whole in the water.
abstract.cn: 看夜湖中完完整整沉在水里的月亮。

abstract.en: Feel the air before a storm, thick and refusing to stir.
abstract.cn: 体会暴风雨前浓稠不动的空气。

abstract.en: Freeze one film frame in your mind and watch it refuse to move.
abstract.cn: 在脑中定格一帧电影画面，看它拒绝移动。

examples.en: Please hold still while I tie your shoe.
examples.cn: 系鞋带时请别乱动。

examples.en: After all these years, the door still squeaks.
examples.cn: 这么多年过去，那扇门还是吱呀作响。

examples.en: We lost the match; still, we learned a lot.
examples.cn: 我们输了比赛，不过学到了很多。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯提尔」——谐音「死贴」：湖面死贴着月亮的倒影，一动不动。

root: 源自古英语 stille（不动的、安静的），一般认为上溯至日耳曼语 *stilli-（固定、静止）；与 stiff、stick 无词源关系。

sensesIntro.en: The motionless lake gives the quiet surface, the unchanging hour, the contrast despite calm, one more degree of it, and the single frozen frame.
sensesIntro.cn: 不动的湖面给出寂静的水面、经时不改、平静中的转折、更进一步的程度，以及一帧凝固的画面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a night lake whose mirror face never moves
core.cn: 核心意象：一面永不动摇的镜面夜湖

branches.en: water and air without movement
the same state continuing to now
contrast spoken over the calm
one more degree beyond the extreme
one instant lifted from the moving world
branches.cn: 从流动世界截取的一瞬

intro.en: Still builds a quiet family of nouns and fixed expressions.
intro.cn: still 构成一个围绕「静止」的词族与固定表达。

latinIntro.en: Still has no Latin relatives; it is native Germanic, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: still 没有拉丁同源词，属日耳曼本土词源，故拉丁同族词列表为空。

items.meaning: complete quiet and lack of movement
dead at birth; failing from the start
items.meaningCN: 死产的；从一开始就失败的

items.meaning: an apparatus for making spirits, called a still
items.meaningCN: 蒸馏器（名词 still 的另一义）

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「寂静；静止」
由本词加复合成分 born 构成，义为「死产的；胎死腹中的」
由本词加复数后缀构成，义为「剧照；静止画面」

definition_zh: 搅拌；搅动；（使）微动；激起；轰动；唤醒
definition_en: to move a liquid around with a spoon, or to wake a feeling and make people excited
core_image: 一把勺子画圈搅开沉底的糖——糖粒旋起，水面生涡
scene: 周末早晨，奶奶在灶台前煮麦片粥。She stirred the porridge slowly so it would not burn at the bottom.
sceneCN: 这里 stir 是动词「搅拌」（第 1 个义项：用勺使液体转动）；句意为她慢慢搅着麦片粥，免得糊底。

pos.zh: 动词：搅拌；搅动；激起；（使）微动

derivatives.zh: 由本词现在分词转作形容词，义为「激动人心的」
由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「搅拌棒；搬弄是非者」
由本词加复合成分构成，义为「翻炒」

senses.title: To move a liquid or mixture around with a tool
senses.definition: to turn a spoon or similar tool round and round in a liquid or mixture
senses.definitionCN: 用勺子等工具在液体或混合物中画圈转动
senses.example: Stir the paint well before you start.
senses.exampleCN: 开刷之前把油漆搅匀。
senses.why: The spoon draws circles and lifts what has settled at the bottom.
senses.whyCN: 勺子画圈，把沉底的糖粒旋起，即搅拌。

senses.title: To move slightly, or begin to wake
senses.definition: to make a small movement, or begin to become active after sleep or rest
senses.definitionCN: 轻微移动，或在睡眠、休息后开始活动起来
senses.example: The baby stirred just before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 天快亮时婴儿动了一下。
senses.why: The settled sugar shivers before the whirl forms.
senses.whyCN: 涡流成形前，沉底的糖粒先轻轻一颤，即微动。

senses.title: To wake a feeling or make people excited
senses.definition: to make feelings, memories, or interest become active
senses.definitionCN: 使情感、回忆或兴趣活跃起来
senses.example: The old song stirred memories of her hometown.
senses.exampleCN: 这首老歌唤起了她对故乡的回忆。
senses.why: The spoon reaches down and lifts what lay still inside.
senses.whyCN: 勺子探到底，把沉在心里的东西旋起，即唤起。

senses.title: Excitement spreading among people
senses.definition: a state of excitement or interest spreading through a group, used as a noun
senses.definitionCN: 在人群中蔓延的兴奋或关注，作名词使用
senses.example: The new policy caused a stir in the press.
senses.exampleCN: 新政策在媒体界引起轰动。
senses.why: One spoon-stroke and the whole pot turns together.
senses.whyCN: 一勺搅下，整锅水一起转动，即群体骚动。

intro.en: Stir is an Old English word for moving or troubling something, from a Germanic root of agitating.
intro.cn: stir 源自古英语，指搅动、扰动，一般认为出自日耳曼语「使翻动」词根。

items.en: A reconstructed root *stur- is thought to mean to agitate or disturb.
items.cn: 一般认为重构词根 *stur- 意为翻搅、扰动。

items.en: Styrian meant to move, trouble, or disturb something.
items.cn: 古英语 styrian 意为移动、搅扰某物。

items.en: Stiren covered stirring food, waking, and being roused to action.
items.cn: 中古英语 stiren 兼指搅动食物、醒来与被激起行动。

items.en: The emotional and public senses grew: stirring speeches, a stir in town.
items.cn: 情感与公众义发展：激动人心的演说、城中的轰动。

items.en: Stir-fry entered from Chinese cooking, and stir-crazy named restless confinement.
items.cn: stir-fry 经中餐进入英语，stir-crazy 形容被关得发闷。

note.en: Stir looks like the unrelated star, and sits near mixing words of different roots.
note.cn: stir 拼写上与不相关的 star 相近，义场靠近词源不同的混合词。

entries.definition: a burning ball of gas in the sky, or a famous person
entries.definitionCN: 星星；明星；与 stir 只差一个字母，词源不同

entries.definition: a metal loop for the foot when riding a horse
entries.definitionCN: 马镫；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: exciting strong feelings
entries.definitionCN: 激动人心的；由 stir 派生的形容词

entries.definition: to combine things so they blend together
entries.definitionCN: 混合；掺和，强调合并为一体

entries.definition: to beat quickly with a wire tool
entries.definitionCN: 搅打；用打蛋器快速搅，比 stir 更猛

entries.definition: to wake someone or make them active
entries.definitionCN: 唤醒；激起，对应 stir 的唤醒义

entries.definition: to make peaceful and still
entries.definitionCN: 使平静；安抚，与搅动相反

normalIntro.en: The spoon-circle image serves cooking, waking, and public excitement alike.
normalIntro.cn: 勺子画圈的画面同时服务烹调、唤醒与公众骚动。

normal.en: Stir, stirred, stirred is the regular verb chain.
normal.cn: stir—stirred—stirred 是规则动词变化链。

normal.en: Stir up trouble and stir up memories share one phrase.
normal.cn: stir up trouble 与 stir up memories 共用 stir up 短语。

normal.en: Cause a stir means to attract excited public attention.
normal.cn: cause a stir 指引起公众的热切关注。

normal.en: Stir-fry is the kitchen word for cooking quickly in oil.
normal.cn: stir-fry 是大火快炒的厨房用语。

normal.en: Not stir an inch is an idiom for refusing to move.
normal.cn: not stir an inch 表示一动不动、拒绝挪步。

abstract.en: Watch sugar crystals spiral up from the bottom of a glass.
abstract.cn: 看糖粒从杯底旋升而起。

abstract.en: Feel a sleeping town stir as its first lights come on.
abstract.cn: 感受沉睡的小镇随第一盏灯亮而苏醒。

abstract.en: Hear a speech whose words lift a whole hall together.
abstract.cn: 听一场让全场一起沸腾的演讲。

examples.en: He stirred his coffee and read the morning paper.
examples.cn: 他搅了搅咖啡，读起晨报。

examples.en: The film stirred deep feelings in the audience.
examples.cn: 这部电影激起了观众深深的情感。

examples.en: The court ruling caused a stir across the country.
examples.cn: 法院裁决在全国引起轰动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯特」——谐音「死特（搅）」：勺子死命画圈特搅，糖粒全起来。

root: 源自古英语 styrian（搅动、扰动），一般认为上溯至日耳曼语 *stur-（翻搅）；与 star、stirrup 无词源关系。

sensesIntro.en: The spoon-circle gives the mixing hand, the small shiver of waking, the lifted feeling, and the pot-wide excitement of a crowd.
sensesIntro.cn: 勺圈给出搅动的手、初醒的微颤、被旋起的情感，以及满锅般的人群骚动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a spoon drawing circles that lift the settled sugar
core.cn: 核心意象：勺子画圈，旋起沉底的糖粒

branches.en: the mixing hand at work
the first shiver before motion
feelings lifted from their rest
a whole group turning at once
waking from sleep and from silence

intro.en: Stir grows cooking compounds and feeling words with ease.
intro.cn: stir 轻松衍生出烹饪复合词与情感词。

latinIntro.en: Stir has no Latin relatives; it is native Germanic, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: stir 没有拉丁同源词，属日耳曼本土词源，故拉丁同族词列表为空。

items.meaning: exciting strong feeling; the action of mixing
a tool or person that stirs
makes nouns for tools or doers
items.meaningCN: 名词后缀，表工具或施动者

items.meaning: restless from being shut in too long

由本词加名词后缀 -er 构成，义为「搅拌棒；搬弄是非者」
由本词加复合成分 fry 构成，义为「翻炒」

definition_zh: 库存；存货；股票；股份；汤底；家系；备有；储存
definition_en: goods kept for sale, shares of a company, soup base, or to keep a supply of something
core_image: 仓库货架上一排排码好的纸箱——取用有序，随时补上
scene: 年末大促前夜，店员按清单清点货架。The shop keeps extra stock on the shelves before the holiday rush.
sceneCN: 这里 stock 是名词「库存」（第 1 个义项：备售的货物）；句意为节日抢购前，店里会在货架备足库存。

pos.zh: 名词：库存；股票；汤底；家系
形容词：常备的；老一套的

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「经销商；存货商」
由本词加复合成分构成，义为「储备物资；囤积」
由 over- 加本词构成，义为「进货过多」

senses.title: Goods kept ready for sale or use
senses.definition: a supply of goods kept in a shop or warehouse for selling or use
senses.definitionCN: 商店或仓库中备售、备用的货物
senses.example: The winter coats are out of stock until next week.
senses.exampleCN: 冬季外套缺货，下周才有。
senses.why: The stacked boxes on the shelf, counted and ready to hand over.
senses.whyCN: 货架上码好的纸箱，被清点、随时交付，即存货。

senses.title: Shares of a company that can be bought and sold
senses.definition: the money lent to a company in exchange for part ownership, traded as shares
senses.definitionCN: 借给公司换取部分所有权的资金，以股份形式交易
senses.example: She bought stock in the railway company twenty years ago.
senses.exampleCN: 她二十年前买了那家铁路公司的股票。
senses.why: Each box in the storehouse is a slice of the whole business you can own.
senses.whyCN: 库房里每箱货都是整个生意中可拥有的一格份额，即股份。

senses.title: Liquid made by boiling meat, fish, or bones
senses.definition: a liquid made by simmering bones or meat, used as a base for soup
senses.definitionCN: 用骨头或肉慢煮出的液体，作汤的基础
senses.example: Add two cups of chicken stock to the sauce.
senses.exampleCN: 在酱汁里加两杯鸡汤底。
senses.why: The storehouse of flavor, kept in pots like goods on shelves.
senses.whyCN: 风味的仓库，如货架上的货物一样存于锅中，即汤底。

senses.title: The line of animals or plants a person or group comes from
senses.definition: the family line of people, animals, or plants one descends from
senses.definitionCN: 人、动物或植物所出的世系
senses.example: He comes from farming stock going back five generations.
senses.exampleCN: 他出身五代务农的农家。
senses.why: The storehouse is the family itself, keeping goods of its own kind.
senses.whyCN: 家族本身就是一座保存同类「货品」的仓库，即血统。

senses.title: To keep a supply of something ready
senses.definition: to fill a place with goods for future sale or use
senses.definitionCN: 把货物备足以供日后销售或使用
senses.example: The store stocks fresh bread from a local bakery.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店备有本地面包房的新鲜面包。
senses.why: The hands that stack the boxes on the shelf.
senses.whyCN: 把纸箱码上货架的那双手，即备货。

intro.en: Stock began as a tree trunk in Old English, then grew into storehouses, family lines, and traded shares.
intro.cn: stock 在古英语中原指树干，后生长出仓库、家系与交易的股份诸义。

items.en: A reconstructed root *stuk- or *stakk- is thought to mean trunk or post.
items.cn: 一般认为重构词根 *stuk-/*stakk- 意为树干、桩柱。

items.en: Stocc meant a tree trunk or post, used as a support or a mark of shame in the stocks.
items.cn: 古英语 stocc 指树干、木柱，可用作支撑，也用作刑具（颈手枷）。

items.en: The trunk image gave the family line (from the same stock) and stored goods.
items.cn: 树干意象生出「家系」（from the same stock）与储存货物之义。

items.en: Government borrowed money as stock, and shares became tradable in the stock market.
items.cn: 16–18 世纪政府以 stock 名义借钱，股份进入证券市场交易。

items.en: Cooking stock, stock characters, and stock up on spread into daily use.
items.cn: 高汤、定型角色与 stock up on（囤货）等用法进入日常语言。

note.en: Stock looks like the unrelated stick and stack, and its true family hides in tree-trunk words.
note.cn: stock 拼写上与不相关的 stick、stack 相近，真正的词族藏在「树干」类词中。

entries.definition: a neat pile of things one on another
entries.definitionCN: 堆；垛；与 stock 只差一个字母，词源不同

entries.definition: a thin piece of wood, or to become fixed
entries.definitionCN: 棍；粘住；拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: unable to move or escape, past of stick
entries.definitionCN: 卡住的；stick 的过去式，与 stock 无关

entries.definition: a complete list of goods held, or the goods themselves
entries.definitionCN: 清单；库存（正式说法），强调盘点在册

entries.definition: an amount of something kept available for use
entries.definitionCN: 供应；储备，强调可供使用量

entries.definition: one of the equal parts of a company's ownership
entries.definitionCN: 股份；份额，与 stock 的证券义相近

entries.definition: to sell all of one's stock or shares
entries.definitionCN: 售罄；清仓，与备货相反

normalIntro.en: One warehouse shelf carries boxes, shares, soup, and family lines.
normalIntro.cn: 一排仓库货架承载货物、股份、高汤与家系。

normal.en: In stock and out of stock are the shop phrases everyone knows.
normal.cn: in stock 与 out of stock 是人人都懂的店铺用语。

normal.en: Take stock of means to review your situation carefully.
normal.cn: take stock of 指审视形势、盘点处境。

normal.en: Stock up on food before the holiday rush.
normal.cn: 节日抢购前先囤足食物，stock up on 即囤货。

normal.en: Chicken stock and beef stock are soup bases, not shop goods.
normal.cn: chicken stock、beef stock 是汤底，不是店铺货物。

normal.en: From good stock means from a good family line.
normal.cn: from good stock 指出身好门第，体现家系义。

abstract.en: See rows of labeled boxes in a dim warehouse, waiting.
abstract.cn: 看昏暗仓库里一排排贴着标签、静静待领的纸箱。

abstract.en: Feel a pot of bones simmering down into amber liquid gold.
abstract.cn: 体会一锅骨头熬成琥珀色汤底的过程。

abstract.en: Picture a family tree whose trunk keeps its own kind of goods.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵家系树，树干里存着自家的「货品」。

examples.en: Those sneakers are back in stock in all sizes.
examples.cn: 那款运动鞋全码补货上架了。

examples.en: Tech stocks fell sharply this morning.
examples.cn: 科技股今晨大幅下跌。

examples.en: The pantry is stocked with rice, flour, and canned food.
examples.cn: 食品储藏室备有米、面粉和罐头食品。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯托克」——谐音「死头磕」：仓库货架高，磕头也搬不完的死库存。

root: 源自古英语 stocc（树干、木柱），一般认为上溯至日耳曼语 *stuk-/*stakk-（干、桩）；由「树干」引申出「家族之根」「储存之物」；与 stick、stack 无词源关系。

sensesIntro.en: From the standing trunk grow the family line, the stored goods, the tradable slices of a business, the pot of flavor, and the hands that fill shelves.
sensesIntro.cn: 从立定的树干生长出家系、储存的货物、可交易的生意份额、风味之汤，以及填满货架的手。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: stacked boxes on a warehouse shelf, counted and ready
core.cn: 核心意象：仓库货架上码好、清点待领的纸箱

branches.en: goods stacked for sale
ownable slices of a business
the flavor storehouse in a pot
the family trunk itself
the hands that fill the shelves

intro.en: Stock compounds freely, from trading floors to kitchens.
intro.cn: stock 构词能力强，从交易大厅到厨房皆有其复合词。

latinIntro.en: Stock has no Latin relatives; it is native Germanic, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: stock 没有拉丁同源词，属日耳曼本土词源，故拉丁同族词列表为空。

a dealer who keeps goods in stock
a large stored amount for future use
farm animals kept for use or sale

definition_zh: 胃；肚子；腹部；食欲；胃口；忍受（stomach it）
definition_en: the organ where food is digested, the front part of the body below the chest, or the desire to eat
core_image: 一只 tucked 在肋骨下的口袋——食物进来，慢慢揉碎
scene: 孩子连跑带跳地吃完午饭就去了操场。Running right after eating gave him a stomach ache in the afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 stomach 是名词「胃；肚子」（第 1 个义项：消化器官）；句意为饭后立刻奔跑使下午胃疼。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加复合成分构成，义为「胃痛；腹痛」
由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「健胃的；助消化的」
由本词加量词后缀构成，义为「一胃的量；饱足」

senses.title: The organ that digests food
senses.definition: the bag-like organ inside the body where food begins to be digested
senses.definitionCN: 体内开始消化食物的袋状器官
senses.example: The doctor said his stomach was perfectly healthy.
senses.exampleCN: 医生说他的胃完全健康。
senses.why: The hidden pocket under the ribs where food is kneaded.
senses.whyCN: 肋下那只揉碎食物的暗袋，即胃。

senses.title: The front of the body below the chest
senses.definition: the front part of the body between the chest and the legs, also called the belly
senses.definitionCN: 胸部以下、两腿之间的身体前部，也称腹部
senses.example: He lay on his stomach and crawled under the bed.
senses.exampleCN: 他趴着爬到床底下。
senses.why: The pocket from outside: the surface over the hidden bag.
senses.whyCN: 从外面看到的那只「口袋」：盖住暗袋的表面，即肚腹。

senses.title: The desire or appetite to eat
senses.definition: the wish to eat food, as in having no stomach for breakfast
senses.definitionCN: 进食的愿望，如没有吃早餐的胃口
senses.example: The heat took away everyone's stomach for lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 暑热让大家都没了吃午饭的胃口。
senses.why: The pocket that opens for food—or refuses to.
senses.whyCN: 那只为食物张开（或拒绝张开）的口袋，即胃口。

senses.title: To accept or bear something unpleasant
senses.definition: to be able to accept something unpleasant without objecting, used with can't or could not
senses.definitionCN: 能够接受不快之事而不反对，与 can't 连用
senses.example: She couldn't stomach the rude way he treated the staff.
senses.exampleCN: 她无法忍受他对待员工的粗鲁态度。
senses.why: Swallowing what you cannot digest—and refusing it.
senses.whyCN: 咽下消化不了的东西——或者干脆咽不下去，即忍受与否。

intro.en: Stomach came through Old French from Latin stomachus, which itself borrowed Greek stomachos, the throat or gullet.
intro.cn: stomach 经古法语借自拉丁语 stomachus，后者又借自希腊语 stomachos（喉、食道）。

items.en: A reconstructed root *stom- is thought to mean mouth or opening.
items.cn: 一般认为重构词根 *stom- 意为嘴、开口。

items.en: Stomachos meant throat or gullet, the passage of food.
items.cn: 希腊语 stomachos 指喉、食道，即食物的通道。

items.en: Stomachus shifted to mean thedigestive organ, and also courage or pride.
items.cn: 拉丁语 stomachus 转指消化器官，也引申为勇气、傲气。

items.en: Estomac and stomach entered English for the organ, keeping the courage sense briefly.
items.cn: 14 世纪经古法语 estomac 进入英语指胃，短暂保留「勇气」义。

items.en: The appetite and bear-it senses grew, and stomach ache became a household phrase.
items.cn: 食欲与忍受义发展起来，stomach ache 成为家常用语。

note.en: Stomach comes from Greek throat words, and sits near belly words of different roots.
note.cn: stomach 源自希腊语的「喉」类词，义场靠近词源不同的腹部词。

entries.definition: goods for sale, company shares, or soup base
entries.definitionCN: 库存；股票；汤底；与 stomach 拼写部分相近但词源不同

entries.definition: a decorative panel worn over the chest in old dress
entries.definitionCN: 旧式胸饰；与 stomach 同根的历史词

entries.definition: violent weather with wind and rain
entries.definitionCN: 暴风雨；拼读相近但词源不同

entries.definition: the front part of the body below the chest
entries.definitionCN: 肚子（口语），源自古英语，与 stomach 词源不同

entries.definition: the stomach or belly, said by or to children
entries.definitionCN: 肚肚（儿语），亲昵说法

entries.definition: the lower body part containing the digestive organs
entries.definitionCN: 腹部（医学用语），强调解剖部位

entries.definition: to give food to someone or something
entries.definitionCN: 喂食；投喂，是与胃直接相关的动作

normalIntro.en: One pocket under the ribs serves the organ, the belly, the appetite, and what you can swallow.
normalIntro.cn: 肋下那只口袋同时承担器官、肚腹、食欲与能否咽下。

normal.en: On an empty stomach is the fixed phrase for eating without food first.
normal.cn: on an empty stomach（空腹）是固定说法。

normal.en: Can't stomach it uses the word as a verb for refusing to bear.
normal.cn: can't stomach it 把该词作动词，指无法忍受。

normal.en: Butterflies in my stomach describes nerves, not real insects.
normal.cn: butterflies in my stomach 形容紧张，并非真有蝴蝶。

normal.en: The plural is stomachs: the stomachs of both dogs.
normal.cn: 复数是 stomachs：两条狗的胃。

normal.en: Stomach ache is written as one word or two in different books.
normal.cn: stomach ache 有的书写作一个词，有的写作两个词。

abstract.en: Feel the warm hidden pocket kneading each bite slowly.
abstract.cn: 体会肋下温暖的暗袋慢慢揉碎每一口食物。

abstract.en: Picture a fly circling inside when nerves take over.
abstract.cn: 想象紧张袭来时腹中盘旋的蝴蝶。

abstract.en: Feel the swallow that stops halfway when something is unbearable.
abstract.cn: 体会无法容忍时咽到一半停住的感觉。

examples.en: Don't swim on a full stomach.
examples.cn: 吃饱后不要游泳。

examples.en: I have no stomach for another argument today.
examples.cn: 今天我没心情再吵一场。

examples.en: He couldn't stomach the constant lying.
examples.cn: 他无法忍受不断的谎言。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯特马克」——谐音「死多嗑」：胃里死命多嗑几口，全都装下。

root: 经古法语 estomac 借自拉丁语 stomachus，后者借自希腊语 stomachos（喉、食道）；一般认为印欧词根 *stom- 与「嘴、开口」相关；与 stock、storm 无词源关系。

sensesIntro.en: From the food passage grow the digesting pocket, the belly surface, the appetite that opens it, and the refusal to swallow what cannot be borne.

the wish that opens the pocket

definition_zh: 石头；石料；果核；结石
definition_en: a hard piece of rock, rock used for building, or the hard seed of a fruit
core_image: 一块被溪水磨得光滑的灰色石头
scene: 孩子们在河边捡石头。The children picked up stones by the river.
sceneCN: 这里 stone 是「石头」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们在河边捡石头。

derivatives.zh: 多石的；冷酷的
冷酷地
多石；冷酷

senses.title: A piece of rock
senses.definition: a hard solid piece of rock
senses.definitionCN: 一块坚硬的岩石
senses.example: The children picked up stones.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们捡起了石头。
senses.why: This is the basic object sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的实物义项。

senses.title: Building rock
senses.definition: rock cut and used as a building material
senses.definitionCN: 切割后用作建筑材料的岩石
senses.example: The house is built of stone.
senses.exampleCN: 这房子是用石头建的。
senses.why: The material takes the name of its pieces.
senses.whyCN: 材料沿用了石块的名字。

senses.title: The seed of fruit
senses.definition: the hard seed inside a fruit
senses.definitionCN: 水果内部坚硬的种子
senses.example: He removed the stone from the peach.
senses.exampleCN: 他把桃核取了出来。
senses.why: The hard seed looks like a small stone.
senses.whyCN: 坚硬的果核像一块小石头。

senses.title: A hard mass in the body
senses.definition: a small hard mass that forms inside the body
senses.definitionCN: 体内形成的小硬块
senses.example: He passed a kidney stone.
senses.exampleCN: 他排出了一颗肾结石。
senses.why: The body forms its own small stones.
senses.whyCN: 身体自己也会长出不小的石头。

intro.en: Stone is one of the oldest Germanic words in English.
intro.cn: stone 是英语中最古老的日耳曼语词之一。

items.en: The root named hard rock.
items.cn: 该词根指坚硬的岩石。

items.en: Stone also named building material.

items.en: Stone named the hard seed of fruit.

items.en: Stone named hard masses in the body.

note.en: Stone is compared with look-alike words and with words for rock.

normalIntro.cn: 石头坚硬、沉重，比用它建成的任何东西都古老。

normal.en: The stone is heavy.
normal.cn: 这块石头很重。

normal.en: The wall is made of stone.
normal.cn: 这堵墙是石头砌的。

normal.en: The peach has a hard stone.
normal.cn: 桃子有个硬核。

normal.en: They left no stone unturned.
normal.cn: 他们想尽了办法。

normal.en: The school is a stone's throw away.
normal.cn: 学校就在一箭之遥。

abstract.en: A stone remembers every hand that lifted it.
abstract.cn: 石头记得每一双搬过它的手。

abstract.en: Hard stone, soft water, and time wins.
abstract.cn: 硬石头，软流水，时间最后赢。

abstract.en: A heart of stone feels nothing, which is not a gift.
abstract.cn: 铁石心肠什么都感受不到，这并非恩赐。

examples.cn: 孩子们在河边捡石头。

examples.en: The house is built of stone.
examples.cn: 这房子是用石头建的。

examples.en: He removed the stone from the peach.
examples.cn: 他把桃核取了出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: stone 是「石头」，也指「石料」「果核」「结石」；a stone's throw 是一箭之遥，leave no stone unturned 是想尽一切办法。

sensesIntro.en: Stone is a piece of rock, building rock, the hard seed of fruit, or a hard mass in the body.
sensesIntro.cn: stone 是石头、石料、果核，或体内的结石。

core.en: Hard matter that outlasts soft hands.
core.cn: 比柔软的手更久存的坚硬物质。
